FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Quick Bites Family Diner, we strive to provide a welcoming and family-friendly dining experience with a focus on quick service. Our restaurant features a modern, clean design, occupying a total floor area of 7,500 square feet, which allows us to efficiently serve our guests without exceeding local operational guidelines. We offer a diverse menu that includes burgers, sandwiches, salads, and kid-friendly meals, ensuring there's something for everyone in the family. With no more than 150 seats, we prioritize an accessible environment that fosters a relaxed atmosphere for our customers. 

In adherence to our commitment to safety and quality, we maintain rigorous health and safety standards, ensuring that all staff are thoroughly trained in food handling and hygiene practices. Our restaurant's operations are supported by regular maintenance of kitchen equipment and fire suppression systems, helping to prevent any safety hazards. Additionally, we do not serve alcoholic beverages, simplifying our operational risks and enhancing our focus on serving delicious meals to families and quick-service patrons alike.

Our fast food and family restaurant spans 9,000 square feet, providing ample space for dining, kitchen operations, and family-friendly activities to enhance our customers' experience.
